title: Resolve Java var captures before generating helper parameters
wanted_capability: Java extract-method code-block generation should never emit `var` in a helper method parameter. When a captured local was declared with `var`, the planner should resolve a usable explicit type from syntax/LSP/source context or fail closed before producing uncompilable Java.
missing_primitive: Explicit type resolution for Java `var` captures in extract-method parameter lists
fallback_used: The probe identified the concrete type from source usage and the generated helper signature was repaired manually in the disposable worktree before recompiling.
notes: Generic finding from a private Java probe. The result-record path worked for multiple live-outs, but one captured input had inferred local type `var`; that value was then emitted as a helper parameter type, which Java method signatures cannot use.
resolution_note: Addressed by commit adding fail-closed helper parameter validation: java extract-method generation now refuses inferred/var/empty helper parameter types before returning edits, and the code-mode binding explains how to re-call with explicit parameters/arguments. A deeper semantic type resolver remains a possible separate enhancement.
